name: book-cover-designer
description: Design book covers like an advanced graphic designer — any genre, any retailer. Concept-first workflow (read-the-text, depiction plane, visual argument), modular grid, typography hierarchy, palette, reference-image templates, and per-retailer export (Amazon KDP, Google Books, Apple Books, print). Portable: works in Claude Code, Codex CLI/Desktop, Grok, OpenCode, Kimi, Ori via bundled CLI + MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Design professional book covers — any genre, any retailer
interface.longDescription: Concept-first book cover design: read the text as a designer, choose a depiction plane, build a visual argument, then compose on a modular grid with disciplined typography. Generates candidates through whichever image provider is available (OpenRouter / OpenAI / xAI Grok / Gemini), supports reference-image style boards, saves reusable templates, and exports to Amazon KDP / Apple Books / Google Play Books / print specs.
defaultPrompt: Design a book cover for my new book
Create a cover concept from these reference images
Generate cover candidates for an Amazon KDP launch
